adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, `update` does not mutate any state; it just `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` exactly like `show`. The routes add both `get "customize/embedding"` and `put "customize/embedding"` pointing to these actions, so the PUT endpoint currently exists without performing an update. This is not a correctness defect in the shown UI flow (hosts are created/updated via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`), but it is a concrete, diff-grounded scope/architecture concern: an update endpoint and client-side `saveChanges()` (`admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6`) that effectively do nothing.
